verdict.rationale: Multi-tenant scoped search keys are a fair question for a search engine, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of scoped or tenant API keys that embed per-user filters: the 'Security' guide heading and Cloud 'Role-Based Access Control' are adjacent controls, and a community comment says Algolia-style secured keys were not available at the time.

support.subject: As a developer, scoped or tenant tokens restrict each end user's searches to their own documents without separate indexes per user
